dct_description_sm:
*Yukon Aerial Imagery* is distributed from the Government of Yukon imagery

repository. This is a dynamic image service containing aerial photographs and

LiDAR imagery for locations in the Yukon, Canada. 





This data is in

Yukon Albers equal area projection. It can be viewed and queried in the

GeoYukon application: [https://mapservices.gov.yk.ca/GeoYukon](https://mapservices.gov.yk.ca/GeoYukon).





For more

information: [geomatics.help@yukon.ca](mailto:geomatics.help@yukon.ca).
